about: A Berry the player's Pokemon Tricks to a wild Pokemon for one of the same kind, and then eats the one it got, is its swap partner's Berry eaten, not its own: its own, still in the wild Pokemon's hand, goes to the bag at the battle's end (Pokemon Central, Raggiro: from the ninth generation what was handed to a wild Pokemon goes back to the bag, Berries the wild Pokemon eats excepted). Before, NoteHeldItemUsedUp matched the eaten Berry by kind, took it for the Pikachu's own Oran Berry eaten, and the one handed over was lost. A level-30 Pikachu holding an Oran Berry (savedit --party's item) is taught Trick and Splash (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash and is given an Oran Berry of its own (set:): the Trick swaps the two Berries, the Pikachu, left at 10 HP (set:), eats the Chansey's at the turn's end, gym.py's player wins the battle, and the Oran Berry is in the bag, which had none, the Pikachu holding nothing. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

new_lines: Pikachu restored its health using its Oran Berry!
